corrections.text: The article says a query of the Hugging Face API listed ten Praxis-1 model repositories under runwayml and that "each was flagged as gated and tagged Apache 2.0". The cited list URL (api/models?author=runwayml&search=praxis) shows ten repositories and the Apache 2.0 tag but contains no gated field. The gating is shown by the repositories' own API entries (gated: "auto", that is, access after accepting conditions) and by the base and droid model pages.

The article says the README's 80 GB requirement and The Robot Report's RTX 5090 statement "describe different configurations (the default bf16 weights and the optional NVFP4 path)". Neither The Robot Report nor Runway's launch post says which configuration its RTX 5090 statement covers; that pairing is the Herald's inference. The README says the NVFP4 option "has not been run in closed loop on an SM120 GPU yet" and that the RTX 5090 peak memory is not measured.
